events.name: Bash
events.head: Check ancestry, tree, crm-starter prompts, probe scripts
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git fetch -q origin main 2>&1|tail -2; git merge-base --is-ancestor cf3d5ff origin/main && echo ANCESTOR_OK; git status --porcelain -- app/src/content/guides cloud/src | head; grep -n "prompt\|Claude Code\|paste" app/src/content/guides/s5-pipeline/s5-crm-starter.ts | head -30; ls app/scripts | grep -i "check-guides\|probe-guides\|probe-flows"; grep -n "check-guides\|probe-guides\|probe-flows" app/package.json

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read crm-starter prompts and run the three probes
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -n 150,200p app/src/content/guides/s5-pipeline/s5-crm-starter.ts | cut -c1-220; cd app; (node scripts/check-guides.mjs 2>&1 | tail -3; echo "---"; node scripts/probe-guides.mjs 2>&1 | tail -3; echo "---"; node scripts/probe-flows.mjs 2>&1 | tail -3)

events.text: The remaining prompt only reads the built-in Worker CRM (no local CRM build). Waiting for the probes.

events.input: $ ps aux | grep -c "probe-guides\|probe-flows"; ps aux | grep "probe-" | grep -v grep | cut -c1-200 | head

events.name: Bash

events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; head -30 scripts/probe-guides.mjs | grep -n "localhost\|BASE\|PORT\|http"; head -30 scripts/probe-flows.mjs | grep -n "localhost\|BASE\|PORT\|http"; lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -P | grep -E ":(4399|3000|8787)" | head
